keyword.en: which concrete pumps list 4 cm aggregate
keyword.zh: 哪些混凝土泵印了4厘米骨料

title.en: 4 cm Aggregate Is Printed: 4 cm and below beside the Gravel article
title.zh: 4厘米骨料印在哪些泵上：对照「砾石」时，4 cm and below仍在原页

description.en: 4 cm Aggregate Is Printed. 4 cm and below stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Gravel.
description.zh: 4厘米骨料印在哪些泵上。4 cm and below仍在目录格子里。插图来自「砾石」。

h1.en: 4 cm Aggregate Is Printed: 4 cm and below beside the Gravel article
h1.zh: 4厘米骨料印在哪些泵上：对照「砾石」时，4 cm and below仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists maximum aggregate size 4 cm and below on four concrete pumps in Xingtai: HBT8018, HBT80-16, LZ-60 and the integrated mixer. Those pages also list pipe 100 / 125 mm, except you must still open each page for output and distance. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的四台混凝土泵上标出了最大骨料 4 cm 及以下：HBT8018、HBT80-16、LZ-60 和搅拌泵一体机。这些页面也标出管径 100 / 125 mm，但产量和距离仍要打开各自页面。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel. The picture shows Gravel on a beach in Thirasia, Santorini, Greece. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists maximum aggregate size 4 cm and below on four concrete pumps in Xingtai: HBT8018, HBT80-16, LZ-60 and the integrated mixer. HBT8018 lists 60 m³/h and conveying distance 150 m with height 450 m. The shared aggregate sentence does not equalise those distance entries. Only LZ-80 and Diesel 120 list 6 cm and below.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel。画面是Gravel on a beach in Thirasia, Santorini, Greece。河北品锦机械在邢台的四台混凝土泵上标出了最大骨料 4 cm 及以下：HBT8018、HBT80-16、LZ-60 和搅拌泵一体机。HBT80-16 标出 50 m³/h，水平 120 m，高度 360 m。只有 LZ-80 和柴油120标出 6 cm 及以下。

body.en: Those pages also list pipe 100 / 125 mm, except you must still open each page for output and distance. HBT80-16 lists 50 m³/h, horizontal 120 m and height 360 m. Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer list stone-size distance rows. Do not upgrade a 4 cm page to 6 cm because both are diesel or both look large.
body.zh: 这些页面也标出管径 100 / 125 mm，但产量和距离仍要打开各自页面。LZ-60 标出 50 m³/h，输送距离 100 m，高度 300 m。不要因为都是柴油或看起来都大，就把 4 cm 的页面升成 6 cm。

body.en: Electric 50 does not use the 4 cm sentence. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h, conveying distance 100 m and height 300 m. They do not list the sentence 4 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery shown the smaller wording on purpose on the four pages above.
body.zh: 它标出了分开的 13 mm 和 24 mm 距离行，没有最大骨料行。搅拌泵一体机标出 21 m³/h 和 100 m / 300 m。河北品锦机械是在上面四页标出了较小的那种说法。

body.en: It lists separate 13 mm and 24 mm distance rows and no maximum-aggregate line. The integrated mixer lists 21 m³/h and 100 m / 300 m. Use the row heading they do list.
body.zh: HBT8018 标出 60 m³/h，输送距离 150 m，高度 450 m。电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵标出的是按石子粒径分的距离行。

question.en: Which four pumps list 4 cm and below?
question.zh: 哪四台泵标出 4 cm 及以下？

answer.en: HBT8018, HBT80-16, LZ-60 and the integrated mixer. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel.
answer.zh: HBT8018、HBT80-16、LZ-60 和搅拌泵一体机。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does the integrated mixer list a pipe size too?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机也标出管径吗？

answer.en: Yes. 100 / 125 mm, on that page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel.
answer.zh: 标出了。该页为 100 / 125 mm。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 50 list 4 cm and below?
question.zh: 电动50标出 4 cm 及以下吗？

answer.en: No. It lists 13 mm and 24 mm distance rows and no maximum-aggregate line. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel.
answer.zh: 没有。它标出 13 mm 和 24 mm 距离行，没有最大骨料行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Is 4 cm the same entry as 6 cm?
question.zh: 4 cm 和 6 cm 是同一格吗？

answer.en: No. They are different shown wordings on different concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel.
answer.zh: 不是。它们是不同混凝土泵上不同的写出措辞。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel画面里印出的数字。
